name: api-client-importer
displayName: API Client: Import from Thunder Client (draft)
description: Imports Thunder Client collections and environments into plain .http files. Local only: no account, no network, no telemetry.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Importing writes files into the workspace and reads data from other folders, so it needs a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The imported files are written with the file system of the machine the extension runs on.
